entries.title: Psalms 60:1
segments: ¶<<To the Chief Musician. Set to "Lily of the Testimony." A Michtam of David. For teaching. When he fought against Mesopotamia and Syria of Zobah, and Joab returned and killed twelve thousand Edomites in the Valley of Salt.>> O God, You have cast us off; You have broken us down; You have been displeased; Oh, restore us again!

entries.title: Psalms 60:2
segments: You have made the earth tremble; You have broken it; Heal its breaches, for it is shaking.

entries.title: Psalms 60:3
segments: You have shown Your people hard things; You have made us drink the wine of confusion.

entries.title: Psalms 60:4
segments: You have given a banner to those who fear You, That it may be displayed because of the truth. Selah

entries.title: Psalms 60:5
segments: That Your beloved may be delivered, Save [with] Your right hand, and hear me.

entries.title: Psalms 60:6
segments: ¶God has spoken in His holiness: "I will rejoice; I will divide Shechem And measure out the Valley of Succoth.

entries.title: Psalms 60:7
segments: Gilead [is] Mine, and Manasseh [is] Mine; Ephraim also [is] the helmet for My head; Judah [is] My lawgiver.

entries.title: Psalms 60:8
segments: Moab [is] My washpot; Over Edom I will cast My shoe; Philistia, shout in triumph because of Me."

entries.title: Psalms 60:9
segments: Who will bring me [to] the strong city? Who will lead me to Edom?

entries.title: Psalms 60:10
segments: [Is it] not You, O God, [who] cast us off? And You, O God, [who] did not go out with our armies?

entries.title: Psalms 60:11
segments: Give us help from trouble, For the help of man [is] useless.

entries.title: Psalms 60:12
segments: Through God we will do valiantly, For [it is] He [who] shall tread down our enemies.
